text.en:
Item (73), page 737, subparagraph aj, for Mountain Province, paragraph b, Title A, Section three of Republic Act Numbered Nineteen hundred is amended to read as follows:
"(73) Construction and completion of 3 rooms, Mompolia Barrio School, Burnay ₱11,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
